title: Mole Rush
tagline: Sixty seconds, nine burrows, no mercy
description: Moles rise out of a field of nine burrows, stay up for a window that keeps shrinking, and duck straight back. Bonk them before they vanish. Consecutive hits build a multiplier that decays while you hesitate and breaks the moment one escapes, gold moles pay a hundred a piece, and a bomb mole costs you three seconds of a sixty-second run.
instructions: Tap anywhere or press Space to start the sixty-second run.
Tap a mole to bonk it, or press its burrow's number in numpad layout: 7-8-9 across the top row, 4-5-6 across the middle, 1-2-3 across the bottom.
The arrow keys move a bright ring between burrows and Space or Enter swings at the selected one.
Hit moles back to back to raise the multiplier, grab the gold ones for a big bonus, and leave the bombs alone because hitting one costs three seconds.
Press P to pause and M for sound; your best score and longest chain are kept on this device.
